Eric, you absolute coward—Matthew Golden put up 21 points on your bench while you were probably sweating over some washed-up vet you started instead, and now you get to watch that L hit different knowing you benched the game-winner.

Jordan Addison just dropped 20 points on your bench while you were out here starting some JAG, and that's what we call a masterclass in fantasy incompetence—enjoy watching that L from the sidelines, you absolute donkey.

Trevor Lawrence just put up nearly 20 points on your bench while you started whoever the fuck you had at QB instead—congrats on that galaxy brain decision, ESPNFAN6437471416, your "safer floor" pick probably cost you the week.

kconley5 really benched Goff for a fuckin' 3-point ceiling this week, huh? That's what happens when you panic and get cute—dude left 19 points on his bench like a coward.

RGM2215 really said "fuck it, I'm starting De'Von Achane" and watched him put up 1.7 points like some kind of fantasy masochist—that's what you get for thinking Miami's backfield was going to cooperate with your delusions.
